name: Casa Aranya
description:
Casa Aranya is a brand-new ground-floor apartment located in the peaceful Aranya residential development in Estepona, ideally positioned between Estepona town and Marbella. Set close to La Resina Golf & Country Club, the property offers convenient access to nearby beaches, golf courses, restaurants, supermarkets, and the attractions of the Costa del Sol, while providing a calm and contemporary setting for a relaxing stay.

Completed in 2024 and presented in immaculate condition, this stylish two-bedroom apartment has been thoughtfully furnished with a modern Mediterranean aesthetic. Accommodating up to six guests, with two bedrooms and an additional sofa bed in the living area, Casa Aranya is ideal for couples, families, or friends looking for a comfortable and elegant base from which to explore Estepona and the surrounding coastline.

The apartment is arranged entirely on the ground floor and features a bright open-plan living and dining area with large glass doors connecting the interior to the outdoor spaces. The living room offers comfortable seating, a television, and a sofa bed providing additional sleeping space for up to two guests. The dining area provides a welcoming setting for shared meals, while the adjoining modern kitchen is fully equipped for a convenient self-catering stay, with integrated appliances and generous preparation space.

Casa Aranya offers two beautifully presented bedrooms. The main bedroom features a double bed and benefits from its own en-suite bathroom, providing additional privacy and comfort. The second bedroom is furnished with two single beds, making it particularly suitable for families or groups of friends. A second contemporary bathroom serves the rest of the apartment.

One of the property’s key highlights is its generous outdoor living space. The apartment opens onto a spacious furnished terrace of approximately 38 m², complemented by a large garden area. With outdoor seating and dining space, this is an inviting setting for morning coffee, relaxed lunches, or enjoying the warm Mediterranean climate throughout the day.

Guests also benefit from the excellent communal facilities within the Aranya development, including a large outdoor swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, stylish co-working facilities, and beautifully landscaped communal areas. The property further includes one private underground parking space and a private storage room for added convenience.

With its contemporary interiors, flexible accommodation for up to six guests, generous outdoor areas, modern communal facilities, and convenient location close to golf, beaches, and Estepona, Casa Aranya offers an excellent setting for a relaxed Costa del Sol holiday.

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

Don’t forget to ask about our Concierge Service! We look forward to welcoming you.
